Things I used to do

As you get older...

...you become aware that you've stopped doing things you used to enjoy. Not everything, of course. But certainly things that maybe you took for granted at the time. Perhaps because:

  • The days seemed longer somehow
  • There was always enough money (maybe you weren't paying)
  • Your time was your own

Once upon a time, I used to:

  1. Ride a bike
  2. Enjoy holidays on the coast
  3. Go hill-walking in the snow

So what about now?

Thinking about these things, and looking up public photos, was a bittersweet experience. I feel nostalgic for the past, but at the same time I do know that there's always tomorrow, and there are new things to discover, right around the corner.

Well, maybe the corner after that...
